verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents public APIs across its main products. The CKS API can create, list, update and delete clusters. The Inference API controls gateways, deployments and capacity claims, uses Bearer-token auth and offers generated clients in Go, Python, TypeScript and other languages. API access tokens are documented, object storage is S3-compatible, and a FOCUS usage API (Public Preview) and a Terraform provider round out programmatic control. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, explicit API coverage for node pools and capacity/quotas (quota and capacity docs reference only the Cloud Console)
